## Loading our Dataset and Checking dimensions

```{r}
load("12_DataSaving.RData")
source("03_funct_EDA.R")
dim(clean_data)

```

## Data Preparation

```{r}
eda_data <- create_low_back_group(clean_data)
table(eda_data$low_back_group, useNA = "ifany")
```

## Missing Data

```{r}
variables <- c(
  "back_pain",
  "site_low_back",
  "lumbar_flexion_cm",
  "chest_expansion_cm",
  "occiput_wall_cm"
)

sapply(eda_data[variables], function(x) {
  sum(is.na(x))
})

```

## Summary Statistics

```{r}
# Lumbar flexion
summary_by_group(eda_data, "lumbar_flexion_cm")

# Chest expansion
summary_by_group(eda_data, "chest_expansion_cm")

# Occiput-to-wall distance
summary_by_group(eda_data, "occiput_wall_cm")

```

## Visualizations

```{r}
# Lumbar Flexion boxplot
plot_group_box(eda_data,"lumbar_flexion_cm","Lumbar Flexion (cm)")

# Chest expansion boxplot
plot_group_box(eda_data,"chest_expansion_cm","Chest Expansion (cm)")

# Occiput-to-wall boxplot
plot_group_box(eda_data,"occiput_wall_cm","Occiput-to-Wall Distance (cm)")

# Lumbar flexion histogram
plot_histogram(eda_data,"lumbar_flexion_cm","Lumbar Flexion (cm)")
```
